## Report — NKE 2026-10-01 (pilot, AMC)

**T2 decision: BUY, confidence 0.52.**

**One-line thesis:** NIKE goes into this print already washed out — down 47% in a year, 51% below its high, on a consensus bar walked down to $0.44 — so the consumer base rate broadly holds, but its own 10-K warning that Greater China and Converse drag all through fiscal 2027, plus a new CFO's first call, pull it back to barely better than a coin flip.

**Prior → final:** started at 0.55 (D004 base rates: consumer cluster 0.555, n=436; AMC 0.538). Moved to 0.52. Up for the washout (16.5× forward, 1.1× sales, so LR20's torpedo has little left to destroy), for call-heavy option positioning on all three B-family signs at once — and unusually, the 90%-strike put trades *below* the ATM call, so no crash premium is being paid — and for four straight beats against a walked-down bar. Down for three things: the FY2026 10-K says in its own words that Greater China and Converse keep hurting throughout fiscal 2027; Q4's headline $0.72 EPS was $0.52 of one-off IEEPA tariff recovery, so the underlying quarter was about $0.20; and two of NIKE's last four prints moved −10.3% on this exact window. David Denton's first call as CFO (with the Chief Accounting Officer also having left in September) is a reset risk the window can't hedge. The 8.55% implied move is wide enough that it argues for staying near the base rate rather than away from it.

**Predicted deciding variable:** the Greater China and fiscal-2027 guidance on the call — not the EPS surprise. NIKE beat by +466%, +41%, +24% and +81% over the last four quarters and the reactions were +0.05%, −10.3%, −10.3%, +6.1%. The EPS line has no explanatory power for this name.

**Leak probe:** "I don't know" — the print is after my May 2026 cutoff. No leakage.

**Freeze:** not mine to do. No commit hash from me; code freezes this event next in the full checkout.

**What went wrong / gaps, stated plainly:**
- **The Q4 FY2026 call transcript could not be retrieved** — no Alpha Vantage key in this job, and every accessible transcript host returned 404 or 403. NIKE gives guidance only on the call, so the specific Q1 FY2027 revenue and margin guide is a real hole in this card. It was not estimated or guessed; the forward view rests on the filed 10-K.
- **One live page was fetched two minutes after `captured_et`** (a stockanalysis.com quote page, ~14:33 vs snapshot 14:31). It is excluded from `inputs_read` and from the reasoning. What it showed — street EPS near $0.44 — matches the $0.437 already in the snapshot, so nothing post-snapshot entered the decision. Recorded in the card rather than left unsaid.
- A Form 144 was filed on the snapshot day with no available filing time, so it could not be shown to precede the snapshot; not read, not used.
- `K_stage` is `unknown`: NIKE doesn't tag `OperatingIncomeLoss`, so D004 §4's formula has no input. Structural, not a fetch failure.

Validation against `freeze.py`'s own checker: 17 inputs, all with `published`, decision and confidence agree, `prior` and `leak_probe` present — no problems.
